decisions.rationale: Account moved fast on first project (day 1) and attended kickoff [calendar:344781df], showing intent, but 6 days in there are no invites, no replies to either outreach [email:a8119720, email:b8d4e622], and no tickets. Single-user accounts with no invite rarely hit the milestone in the remaining 8 days unaided.

draft.subject: Next step after our kickoff
draft.body:
Hi Dara,

Great talking at last week's kickoff — nice work getting your first real project up so quickly. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so the natural next step is getting a teammate in there with you. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if you'd rather add several at once.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first invite with you.

Best,
Priya
